rules.statement: A grand-daughter married in deega is not entitled to a share of her maternal grandfather's immovable property if there are other descendants entitled to inherit.
rules.supporting_quote: "The decision in the case of Menikhamy v. Ransohamy [1 (1930) 11 C. L. R. 31.] also lays down a similar principle in regard to a grand-daughter's claim to succeed to her paternal grand-father's estate."
